name: Violent Unleash
text:
Requirement Your previous action was to Unleash your Psyche.

---
The force of your mind unleashing itself wracks your enemies with a violent shockwave that batters your enemies. You deal ceil@actor.level/2d6 force damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation, with a basic Reflex save save.

At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
